---
title: "Corporate PAC giving by candidate HRC score"
---

How much direct campaign money did each corporate PAC give to candidates, grouped by the
candidate's [Human Rights Campaign](https://www.hrc.org/) Congressional Scorecard score? Pick a PAC below.

::: {.note-box}
**Direct contributions only.** These are contributions made straight to candidate committees.
Money routed through leadership PACs or party committees is not included. Scores are the
**118th Congress (2023-24)** record, applied to donations from both the 2024 and 2026 cycles.
*No score* means the candidate has no HRC score (for example, challengers or new members).
:::

```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
from pals_site import BINS, CYCLE_LABELS, bin_color, load

data = load()
summary = data["summary"].copy()
summary["cycle_label"] = summary["cycle"].map(CYCLE_LABELS)
pacs = sorted(summary["pac"].unique())
alt.data_transformers.disable_max_rows()

pac_p = alt.param(name="pac", value="Google", bind=alt.binding_select(options=pacs, name="PAC: "))
cycle_p = alt.param(name="cycle", value="All", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["All", "2024", "2026"], labels=["Both cycles", "2024", "2026"], name="Cycle: "))
measure_p = alt.param(name="measure", value="Dollars", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["Dollars", "Share of PAC total"], name="Show: "))

# PAC/cycle combos with nothing to show (e.g. Anthropic) get an explicit message
totals = summary.groupby(["pac", "cycle"], as_index=False)["dollars"].sum()
empty = totals[totals["dollars"] == 0].assign(msg="No direct candidate contributions recorded for this PAC and period")

axis_expr = ("measure == 'Dollars' ? '$' + format(datum.value, ',.0f') : format(datum.value, '.0%')")
base = alt.Chart(summary).transform_filter("datum.pac == pac && datum.cycle == cycle")
bars = (
    base.transform_calculate(value="measure == 'Dollars' ? datum.dollars : datum.share")
    .mark_bar()
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("score_bin:O", sort=BINS, title="Candidate HRC score (118th Congress)",
                axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=0)),
        y=alt.Y("value:Q", title="Direct contributions", axis=alt.Axis(labelExpr=axis_expr)),
        color=bin_color(legend=False),
        tooltip=[
            alt.Tooltip("pac:N", title="PAC"),
            alt.Tooltip("cycle_label:N", title="Cycle"),
            alt.Tooltip("score_bin:N", title="HRC score bin"),
            alt.Tooltip("dollars:Q", title="Dollars", format="$,.0f"),
            alt.Tooltip("candidates:Q", title="Candidates"),
            alt.Tooltip("share:Q", title="Share of PAC total", format=".1%"),
        ],
    )
)
message = (
    alt.Chart(empty).transform_filter("datum.pac == pac && datum.cycle == cycle")
    .mark_text(fontSize=15, color="#780000", fontWeight="bold")
    .encode(text="msg:N", x=alt.value(300), y=alt.value(110))
)
chart = (bars + message).add_params(pac_p, cycle_p, measure_p).properties(width="container", height=320)
chart
```

## The numbers behind the chart

Totals across both cycles, in dollars (net of refunds and voided contributions). Candidates are counted once per PAC.

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML
piv = (summary[summary["cycle"] == "All"]
       .pivot(index="score_bin", columns="pac", values="dollars").reindex(BINS))
piv.loc["Total"] = piv.sum()
html = piv.map(lambda v: f"${v:,.0f}").to_html(classes="table table-sm", border=0)
HTML(f'<div class="table-responsive">{html}</div>')
```
